scripts.predev: npm run copy-engine && npm run build-engine
scripts.prebuild: npm run copy-engine && npm run build-engine
scripts.android: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.engine:check: cd engine && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project auto-chess-chess "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.e2e:online: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project auto-chess-chess "playwright test --config playwright.online.config.ts"
scripts.e2e:fullmatch: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project auto-chess-chess "playwright test --config playwright.fullmatch.config.ts"
